race.comment: TRUE TONE (10) has caught the eye in his two race starts and expect to see him settle a touch closer from the low draw. Kept safe in betting when he tackled city class with a fast-finishing fourth over 1550m at Randwick Kensington in a Super Maiden. Key jockey change and sure to go close. MOONLIT WINGS (13) sharp improver second up at the good odds with a tough on-pace fourth to the progressive Sing Your Song over 1400m at Warwick Farm. King sticks and shapes as the main danger. CASTELIQUE (11) returned for her second campaign with a respectable fifth from the rails draw over 1300m at this track. Can make good improvement as she continues to stretch out in distance. IN CIRCLES (3) has finished in the minor money at all three runs this time in. Place best in the small field.
